messages:
Anya (PM): Heads-up — Platform flagged a partner request for a per-route throughput add-on. They want to guarantee higher sustained qps for a subset of routes (webhooks + realtime scoring). Can we draft a spec + launch criteria this week?
Jin (Eng): Quick clarifying q: is this strictly throughput (tokens/sec) or also per-request concurrency/latency priority?
Anya (PM): Mostly throughput floor per route, but partner also asked for lower p95 on that lane if possible. We should separate ‘throughput cap raise’ vs ‘priority lane’.
Sophia (Revenue): To model pricing: partner expects predictable unit pricing and an SLA credit if p95 > X. We should propose a committed throughput block (monthly) + per-overage.
Matt (Product): Proposal sketch: two SKUs — "Throughput Booster" (adds N reserved qps to route) and "Low-Latency Lane" (priority scheduling + 99th pct SLO target). Launch w/ both as optional add-ons.
Oliver (Legal): Don’t forget contractual constraints: add-ons must include auditability for usage (per-route metering) and clear termination/rollback language. Also need KMS/HSM note for private deployments.
pricing-bot: Estimated uplift: Throughput Booster = $X per 1k reserved qps/mo; Low-Latency Lane = 25% premium on compute usage + $Y flat. (estimates provisional)
Jin (Eng): Feasibility notes: we can implement per-route reserved qps via token-bucket + router tagging. Priority lane requires scheduler changes and a fallback path. ETA: booster MVP 3 wks, priority lane 6-8 wks (can canary earlier).
Anya (PM): Launch criteria (draft): 1) 3 pilot partners onboarded, 2) end-to-end per-route metering visible in Console, 3) <150ms p95 for booster routes and <100ms p95 for priority lane in canary, 4) legal + SOC signoff on audit retention.
Sophia (Revenue): Add customer-contract constraints: minimum 3mo commit for booster blocks to avoid churn; overage billing at 150% of committed price. Also add migration credit if partner downgrades within 1st month.
Matt (Product): UX notes: in Console, add per-route toggle + dropdown to attach booster block. Show live utilization graph and estimated spend. Need analytics hooks for alerts if utilization > 80%.
Oliver (Legal): Also require retention window for per-route logs: default 90 days with paid extensions. Add clause for emergency throttling/fallback and notification cadence.
Jin (Eng): Config sketch for infra (example):
```
route_settings:
  - route: "/v1/score/realtime"
    booster_reserved_qps: 2000
    priority_lane: true
```
Will add metrics: booster_reserved_qps_utilization, priority_preemptions.
Anya (PM): Risks: capacity fragmentation, customer expectations mismatch (they may expect unlimited low latency), billing disputes if metering unclear. Mitigations: conservative launch pricing, clear docs, per-route invoice line items.
Sophia (Revenue): Go-to-market: pilot with 2 existing enterprise customers (Finance + Adtech) — target ARR uplift of $80k each if adoption at 50%.
Matt (Product): Action items: 1) Jin to PR infra design by EOW, 2) Legal to draft contract addendum, 3) Revenue to model pricing tiers and churn protection, 4) PM to schedule pilot kickoff.
Jin (Eng): I’ll post rough design tomorrow. Can we lock scope to booster-only for the first pilot to shorten timeline?
Anya (PM): Agreed — pilot = Throughput Booster only. Priority Lane moves to roadmap Q2 if pilot metrics look good.
Sophia (Revenue): Fine w/ pilot scope. Need pricing table by next Wed.
Oliver (Legal): Will start contract template; flag if partner needs SOC / FedRAMP language.
Matt (Product): Thanks — syncing with infra and growth. If anyone has objections to pilot-only scope, speak now or DM. :+1:
Anya (PM): Thanks all — updated spec will land in the product drive and I’ll ping when the PR is up.
